title: Seawise.io Client
description: Share self-hosted apps with family and friends, no port forwarding. Client for the Seawise.io service (free account required).
note: Uses host networking so the client can reach apps on this host at localhost:PORT. Open http://<your-host>:8082 and set a password within 5 minutes of the container starting. Requires a free account at seawise.io.
